utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the book club — I’m a bit fuzzy, but I’m happy to help. What were we deciding again?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not totally sure either, but I think we were talking about what book is next. Do you remember the title?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m afraid I don’t remember the title either, sorry — maybe Mara sent the latest details? If you want, I can help figure it out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll grab a few extra napkins, then—we should be set for book club.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks — I probably missed a couple updates, so that helps. What’s the book and meeting time again?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check the latest details, but I do know we’re set on snacks and tea—just a few extra napkins now. If you want, I’ll send the book and meeting time in a quick note.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, see you then — I’ll save you a seat.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Leo — appreciate it. I’ll bring a couple of my notes and we’ll see what the group thinks tonight.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good, Gus — looking forward to it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, Sam — I’ll resend the book club details and the next Thursday plan at my place. And if you want, I can also include the cozy mystery options Rosa mentioned.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds great, Mara—please resend it when you can. I’d love the cozy mystery options too, and I’ll check which one won.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course — I’ll send the details and a few cozy mystery picks so you can take a look. Looking forward to hearing which one wins!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, are we still doing the book club at your place this week? And can you confirm the day and time for me?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes — we’re still on for book club at my place this week. I’m checking the day and time now, and I’ll make sure you get the details so everyone’s on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great — can you confirm the day and time once you have it, and let me know who’s bringing the snacks?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh good, Eli — that’s exactly the vibe I’m hearing too. If I catch any gossip about the shortlist, I’ll pass it along!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Tess — I appreciate that. I’d still like us to keep the shortlist set ahead of time so we can stay on schedule.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Eli — having the shortlist set ahead of time makes sense. I’ll keep my ears open and let you know as soon as I hear anything!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll drop off the book club details later, and we can sort out the plan after that.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Ira — I’ll check the next meeting spot and who last suggested a book, then I’ll share the details once I have them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, thanks, Opal — that’ll help a lot. I’ll be around when you’re ready, and we can piece it together from there.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I was thinking next Thursday evening still works, and we can keep the book short and easy. If you want, I can suggest a couple of lighter picks.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — Thursday works for me. Send over a couple lighter picks when you can, and I’ll skim them when I have a minute.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure — I’ll send a couple of short, easy options tonight. Hope your day’s been gentle.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, that works for me — I should be free by then. Save me a seat, and I’ll see you at 7.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course — I’ll save you a seat. See you at 7.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, see you at 7 — thanks for saving me a seat.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll pass along the book club plan and circle back once I’ve heard from everyone.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik — that’s very helpful. I’ll keep the options organized and look forward to hearing everyone’s thoughts.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll let everyone know the book club plan and then we can sort out the details together.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, please—what’s on the list?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great — I’ve got us set with "The Midnight Library" to kick things off, and I’ll send the rest of the reading list and meeting details early so everyone can plan ahead.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Perfect—thanks. Can you send me the rest of the list and the meeting time?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still a bit unsure about the exact time and who’s bringing snacks, but I can help sort it out if you want.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, that’d help a lot — I’m probably running late again, but I can still vote on the book and pitch in on snacks if you tell me what you need.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: No problem — I’ll check the time and snack list, then send you the details as soon as I have them so you can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m hoping they choose something light this week. Have you heard any early ideas about the shortlist?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Not yet, but I can ask around and see if there’s a shortlist brewing. I’m mainly hoping they confirm the time and place soon so I can plan my ride.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be great, thanks. Let me know if you hear anything — I’m mainly hoping it’s an easy read and that the details get settled soon.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’d say the best discussions came from the ones with a few big surprises and characters people read very differently. If you want, I can list a couple that really got the room talking.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Sure — but can you confirm the day and time first? And who’s bringing the snacks?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: We meet Thursday at 7 at the Maple Street library, and I’ve got the snacks covered this time. If you’re coming, I can also bring a couple of the most talked-about picks.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll keep my ears open and let you know if I hear any gossip about the shortlist—fingers crossed it’s something light and fun!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Tess — that’d be great. I’m hoping for something light and fun too, and I’ll help gather everyone’s thoughts once we hear more.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect — I’ll ask around and see if anyone’s heard whispers about the shortlist. Hopefully the book club picks something breezy we can all actually enjoy!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I may have missed the email—could you remind me of the title? Then I’ll make sure I’m on the right page.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll remind everyone of the book club plan and the title, then we can sort out the details together.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Vik — what’s the title again, and what day and time are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did we pick a title yet, or are we still deciding tonight?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Not yet — we’re still deciding tonight, so I’ll bring the details by later and we can pick a title then.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks — I’ll be ready to choose when you bring the details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — book club. I think I missed the last update, but I’m in if you tell me what changed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Noah, not much changed — we’re just picking the next read tonight. If you want, I can catch you up on the options and vote with you.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Dane — I’d appreciate that. Keep it short and easy if you can; my brain’s a little scattered today.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I did get it — thanks, Leo. 7 works for me, and I’ll be there after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great — I’ll send the time and place ahead so everyone can plan, and I’ll keep the book list set in advance too. Looking forward to kicking off with "The Midnight Library"!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — thanks, Quinn. I’ve got "The Midnight Library" on my list, and 7 pm still works for me after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll resend the book club details and keep next Thursday at my place on the calendar. Bring those cozy mystery or family-theme options, and we’ll pick something fun for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That sounds perfect, Mara — I’ll bring a couple of short cozy mystery options and maybe one family-theme pick. Thanks for handling the details.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Wonderful — I’m looking forward to it, and I’ll make sure everyone has the details. Your options sound great, Uli!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — let’s keep the plan simple and set the next date before we leave.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll check the list and help set the next date before we go.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, thanks — let’s pick the next date and lock in the book list before we head out.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that sounds lovely—I'd like that. What are we reading next?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll check the list and send the title over soon.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Leo — I’ll keep an eye out for it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — that would really help. Once you have the spot, I’ll let everyone know and keep the book club details organized.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely, Rosa — I’ll check the next meeting spot and report back as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — I appreciate it. I’ll keep everything organized and let the group know as soon as you send the spot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the book club — I’m still a little fuzzy, but I can check with Mara and get you the latest. Want me to resend the details once I have them?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, that’d be great — just send the details when you have them, and I’ll skim them later.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely — I’ll check with Mara and send the latest book club details over as soon as I have them.

injected.text: Update: the book club has been moved from Tuesday at the library to Thursday at the cafe.
